name: Colbun
context: Colbún reservoir dataset from Chile, containing daily measurements of water level, tributary inflow, and precipitation. Colbún is one of the major hydroelectric reservoirs in Chile's Sistema Eléctrico Nacional.

endo.name: water_level
endo.description: Daily average water level in the Colbún reservoir. This is the main target variable for forecasting reservoir behavior and optimizing hydroelectric dispatch.

exo.name: tributary_inflow
exo.description: Daily average tributary inflow (Afluente) in m³/s into the Colbún reservoir. This is the primary exogenous input driving water level dynamics.

exo.name: precipitation
exo.description: Daily precipitation in the Colbún reservoir catchment area. This exogenous variable helps predict future inflow and improves water level forecasting accuracy.
